description: This file defines the ClientStub class, which provides an interface for IPC communication testing, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, sending requests, and handling events related to IPC communication with a mock client.

classes.name: ClientStub
classes.description: A class that encapsulates IPC client stub functionalities for testing, including connection management, request sending, and event handling.
